[RHIM.9.1] A conforming runtime must pass the `hydration_runtime` conformance
kind, which exercises the protocol end to end: the `corr` declaration
check and defaulting (RHIM.2), correlation tagging and completion ordering (RHIM.3), the
budget gate and its `CallError` (RHIM.5.1), the superseding-correlation sweep
(RHIM.5.2), and series-skip (RHIM.5.3).
